roadmap-plan.template: Read AGENTS.md. Load nabla-maintenance. Inspect only the current branch/status/diff and the relevant roadmap section. Return a compact task card with goal, in-scope paths, done evidence, validation, and stop conditions. Do not edit, commit, push, rerun hosted CI, or merge.
roadmap-plan.description: Plan one on-theme roadmap batch without editing

roadmap-next.template: Read AGENTS.md and load nabla-maintenance. Follow OBSERVE → ROUTE → CHANGE → FIX → REVIEW → PROVE → PUBLISH. Implement exactly one finishable batch that fits the current PR theme. Use repository scripts instead of ad-hoc equivalents. If the user request authorizes updating the PR, follow nabla-pr; otherwise stop after local evidence. Never mutate master or merge.
roadmap-next.description: Implement one finishable roadmap batch locally first

ci-diagnose.template: Read AGENTS.md and load nabla-ci-debug. Diagnose the current red check using exact HEAD → workflow/check → job → step → targeted log evidence. Stop when root cause is proven. Do not edit files, rerun hosted CI, push, or merge. Return the root cause and the smallest repair path.
ci-diagnose.description: Diagnose a failing hosted check without editing

qg-fix.template: Read AGENTS.md and load nabla-quality. Run npm run quality:agent:fix, let deterministic hooks converge, then inspect git status --short, git diff --stat, and only the affected diff. Fix only remaining semantic failures. Do not push or merge.

review-batch.template: Read AGENTS.md and load nabla-review. Review only the current intended diff and directly affected contracts. Report blocking findings first with concrete paths and reasons. Do not edit, commit, push, rerun hosted CI, or merge.
review-batch.description: Run a focused read-only review of the current batch

qg-proof.template: Read AGENTS.md and load nabla-quality. Confirm the branch is not master and the working tree is clean. Run or reuse npm run quality:agent:publish, then run npm run quality:agent:publish -- --status. Report the exact QG_* result, HEAD, base, and toolchain proof. Never push on failure and never use --no-verify.
qg-proof.description: Create or audit the strict local publication proof
